Lake Brockman and Logue Brook Campground | Escape the city and reconnect with nature while you relax on the shores of Logue Brook Dam.
Welcome to
Lake Brockman
Tourist Park
and Logue Brook Campground
Escape the city and reconnect with nature while you relax on the shores of Logue Brook Dam. Stay in one of our glamps or cozy cabins or pitch a tent under the stars while you roast your marshmallows, another world awaits just 90 minutes from Perth.
Book Your Stay
Accommodation
A relaxing getaway
Experience the best of Lake Brockman with us
Escape to peace, nature, and endless adventure at Lake Brockman Tourist Park, tucked away in the state forest just 10 minutes from the town of Harvey and roughly 1½ hours south of Perth along the South-West Highway.
The park overlooks the shimmering waters of Logue Brook Dam (also known as Lake Brockman), a dam originally built in 1963, now much loved as a calm, natural playground for families, couples and water lovers alike, pet friendly sites mean you can also bring your furry friends.
Whether you’re after a rugged camping experience in your own tent or caravan, or prefer to relax in comfort with style, Lake Brockman has options for everyone. There are powered and unpowered sites, cosy cabins, family-style glamping tents, and even adults-only glamping tents for a tranquil getaway.
Wake up surrounded by forest, then step out to paddle, swim, or fish in the dam, or simply kick back with a coffee or Devonshire tea on the café balcony overlooking the water and trees.
For families, Lake Brockman delivers versatility: canoeing or kayaking on calm water, trout-fishing year-round (plus marron when in season), water skiing, and relaxing by a campfire under starry skies.
On land, kids can enjoy the playground and BMX pump-track, while adults can enjoy forest walks, biking, or just slow-living, listening to the birds, and soaking up the serenity of nature and the forest.

Features & Facilities
Everything you need for an amazing get-away
View Facilities
Camp Kitchens
We offer two well-equipped camp kitchens within the Tourist Park, providing convenient cooking facilities and comfortable spaces to prepare and enjoy meals.
Amenities blocks
Our Tourist Park features four clean and well-maintained ablution blocks, offering modern bathroom facilities for the comfort of all guests.
Playground
Our playground is a favourite among younger guests, providing a safe and exciting space for outdoor fun and adventure.
Cafe & General Store
Open seven days a week, our café serves great coffee, breakfast and lunch, while our general store stocks those everyday essentials you may have forgotten.
Located beside Logue Brook Dam
Enjoy instant access to swimming, kayaking and stunning water views. Our park sits right beside the beautiful Logue Brook Dam.
Powered & unpowered sites
Choose your ideal campsite with both powered and unpowered options available. Perfect for tents, caravans or camper trailers.
Cabins & glamping with modern comforts
Sleep in comfort with our range of self-contained cabins and luxury glamping tents. Ideal for couples, families or friends.
Recreational waterskiing dam
Logue Brook Dam is a popular spot for waterskiing, wakeboarding and other water sports. Bring your gear and make a splash.
Fishing all year round
Cast a line anytime. The dam is stocked with freshwater fish and offers great fishing opportunities for all experience levels.
Explore Local Activities
Discover Local Adventures
Lake Brockman (Logue Brook Dam) offers a mix of land and water activities, perfect for a holiday with swimming, boating (skiing, kayaking) fishing for trout, camping and exploring nearby trails like the Munda Biddi for biking and the Bibbulmun track for hiking.
Kids can enjoy swimming in the fresh water of the dam, the playground and the BMX pump track. We’re also close to local wineries, national parks and scenic spots, perfect for day trips.
